messages:
maria: who wants to do a pixel party LAN this Thursday 6-10pm on the mezz? casual, bring whatever you want to play.
aj: Im in. do we have enough ethernet ports / switches? wifi might be rough for games.
devon: I can bring a junk 16-port gig switch and a couple of 10m cat6 cables. lightweight.
kenji: I have a dock and a spare Pro controller for Switch folks.
samira: count me in for console chaos. can someone bring a power strip? only one outlet by my desk rn.
ryan: ill handle food — pizza order. pepperoni or veggie? throw your vote. :pizza: :thumbsup: :heart:
aj: pepperoni for sure. also i'll bring two surge strips and an extension.
maria: perfect, thanks devon/kenji/aj/ryan. i'll make a quick signup with slots for PC/console so we don't end up with 6 players for Halo.
samira: can we do a tiny poll here for game suggestions? i vote Smash and Rocket League.
kenji: Smash, Rocket League, and a Mario Kart warmup. maybe a co-op indie like Overcooked for breaks.
aj: for anyone bringing a laptop, plug into the switch and set your NIC to DHCP. if you want static, use something in 10.10.20.x range.

aj: quick helper snippet if you're troubleshooting latency:
```
# check basic connectivity
ping -c 5 8.8.8.8
traceroute 10.10.20.1
```

devon: FYI i'll label cables so we don't create spaghetti.
ops-bot: calendar: "Pixel Party LAN" created by maria for Thu 6:00 PM - 10:00 PM. Room: Mezzanine A.
maria: ops-bot thanks! i'll post a sticky with what to bring (controllers, cables, ethernet adapters) and the pizza poll link.
ryan: pizza poll: pepperoni 7, veggie 3 — looks like pepperoni wins. i'll order at 5:30pm to avoid delivery rush.
samira: anyone with a Switch that needs a dock after 8:30? i might head out early and can lend mine until then.
kenji: i'll take it if needed, thanks samira.
aj: last thing — if you have a USB-C ethernet adapter, bring it. macbooks hate hotel wifi.
maria: great, see you Thursday. bringing some retro pixel art stickers for winners of mini-tourney :trophy: 
ryan: mini-tourney for best speedrun score? i'm ready.
devon: let's keep it chill. also, can someone grab napkins. hospitality is crucial. :laughing:
